name: inkfield-bridge
description: Serves a locally-cloned InkField (https://github.com/ileivoivm/inkField) for human painting over Tailscale, plus a headless render endpoint used by the paint_inkfield bot tool and a drop-page inbox for human-authored recordings. Not a fork or redistribution of InkField — the app itself is bind-mounted read-only from the host clone; this package is only the bridge glue around it.
